title: An Undo whose metadata revert went unanswered is unfinished and finishes on the next press
steps: Run the live-write cases: a push creates a page with metadata; the Undo meets a 503 on apply.revert, or the revert lands and its read-back is blocked; press Undo again; press a third time.
expect: First press: ok:false (WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or LIVE_BLOCKED), the page still published. Second press: ok, state undone, page and meta gone. apply.revert sent twice after the 503, once when it had landed; the third press sends nothing.
evidence: Issue #227 re-test: a 503 on apply.revert answered state partial with failed WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, then repeated

tests: WordPress Undo of a new page with its metadata: revert-503
WordPress Undo of a new page with its metadata: revert-landed-read-unanswered
